gloss: to collect; to recover; to recall

definitions.gloss: to collect; to gather up; to retrieve
definitions.explanation: To collect items that have been distributed or are scattered, bringing them back together.

definitions.gloss: to recall; to withdraw from the market
definitions.explanation: To recall defective products or withdraw items from circulation.

examples.japanese: {古紙|こし}を{回収|かいしゅう}する。
{投資|とうし}した{資金|しきん}を{回収|かいしゅう}できた。
examples.english: I was able to recover the invested funds.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}のボランティアが{海岸|かいがん}のゴミを{回収|かいしゅう}した。
examples.english: Local volunteers collected trash from the beach.

examples.japanese: {欠陥|けっかん}{商品|しょうひん}を{回収|かいしゅう}する。
メーカーが{安全上|あんぜんじょう}の{理由|りゆう}で{製品|せいひん}を{回収|かいしゅう}した。
examples.english: The manufacturer recalled the product for safety reasons.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}メーカーが{不具合|ふぐあい}のあった{車両|しゃりょう}を{全国|ぜんこく}で{回収|かいしゅう}すると{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The automaker announced a nationwide recall of vehicles with defects.

notes:
A versatile verb used for collecting scattered items, recovering costs or investments, and recalling defective products. The noun form {回収|かいしゅう} is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {資源|しげん}{回収|かいしゅう}: resource collection; recycling collection
- {費用|ひよう}を{回収|かいしゅう}する: to recover costs
- {自主|じしゅ}{回収|かいしゅう}: voluntary recall
- リコール{回収|かいしゅう}: recall (of products)
- {回収|かいしゅう}{率|りつ}: collection rate; recovery rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {収集|しゅうしゅう}する: to collect; to gather — focuses on assembling a collection, often of data or specimens
- {集|あつ}める: to gather; to collect — more general and everyday
- リコールする: to recall — specifically for product recalls, borrowed from English
